centre.name: Pacific Community Resources – Chilliwack Addictions And Prevention Services
centre.address: 45921 Hocking Ave, Chilliwack, BC V2P 1B5, Canada

about_blocks.text: CAPS provides effective and coordinated alcohol and drug prevention, intervention, and treatment services for children, youth, and families living in Chilliwack. We follow a bio-psycho-social-spiritual model that aims to meet the individual seeking service where they are at, with a non-judgemental and compassionate view. People will be assessed and heard concerning their needs, then matched with the appropriate service. Individual counselling is offered to people negotiating goal focused plans. Group counselling, office-based and outreach counselling are also offered.

sponsor.text: Are you or a loved one struggling with alcohol or drug addiction? Finding the right addiction treatment centre can make all the difference in achieving long-term recovery. That's why we've done the research for you and compiled a list of the best alcohol and drug addiction centres in Canada. Our list includes top-rated addiction treatment centres that provide evidence-based therapies, personalized treatment plans, and aftercare support services to help clients overcome addiction and maintain a healthy, fulfilling life in recovery. Whether you're looking for residential or outpatient treatment, we've got you covered. For immediate treatment help call: 1-855-885-4747
